Pipelined Agent Workbench

Usage:
  paw [command]

Available Commands:
  bench       Run paw Harbor benchmark sweeps
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  compress    Compress raw context
  doctor      Check local paw setup
  edit        Apply the planned edit
  gather      Gather raw task context
  help        Help about any command
  init        Create a paw config
  models      Inspect configured models
  plan        Plan the next agent step
  resume      Resume a run from its trace
  run         Run the full agent pipeline
  verify      Run verification command
  version     Print version information

Flags:
      --config string       config file
  -h, --help                help for paw
      --log-format string   log format: text, json (default "text")
      --log-level string    log level: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output

Use "paw [command] --help" for more information about a command.
